summary: Frontend-only verification of Tamil/Hindi/English language toggle bug fix on Farm2Home home page. All required strings (top bar, hero H1, hero explore button, Sign In, AI Hub, search placeholder, filter tabs, section headings, footer trust badges) render correctly in Tamil/Hindi/English. Language persists across reload via localStorage key 'farm2home_lang'. No JS pageerror events raised.

issues: 'Cart' label in top-right navbar still renders in English even though translations.js contains Tamil ('கார்ட்') and Hindi ('कार्ट') keys. Suggests Navbar's cart button text is not wrapped with t().

Last trust badge 'Live GPS Tracking' and its subtitle 'Real-time transit from village to doorstep' remain in English despite dictionary entries — likely missing t() wrap on that 4th trust badge in Footer.jsx.
Footer column list items (Organic Fruits, Fresh Vegetables, Aged Grains & Rice, Farmer Portal links etc.) not translated — out of stated scope but worth noting.

action_items: Minor: wrap Navbar 'Cart' label with t('Cart') so it uses the existing Tamil/Hindi dictionary entries.
Minor: wrap the 4th trust badge in Footer.jsx ('Live GPS Tracking' + 'Real-time transit from village to doorstep') with t() — dictionary already has translations.
critical_code_review_comments: translate() helper is clean and defaults to key fallback — good.
Language persisted to localStorage under 'farm2home_lang' — reload persistence verified.
Some UI elements (Cart label, 4th footer badge) missed t() wrapping despite having translations available — consistency gap only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on required assertions, ~95% overall (2 minor untranslated elements)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Language selector is a native <select data-testid='language-selector'> with option values 'English','Tamil','Hindi' (display labels use script). Use page.select_option(..., value='Tamil') NOT label. localStorage key is 'farm2home_lang'. Tamil/Hindi/English switch + reload persistence all verified working. Only two minor untranslated spots remain (Cart button in navbar, 4th Live GPS trust badge in footer).
rca of the issue: Original bug ('Tamil language doesn't change') is FIXED. Verified via reading innerText: hero H1 = 'மண்ணிலிருந்து புத்தம் புதிதாக,\nநேரடியாக உங்கள் வீட்டிற்கு' in Tamil and 'मिट्टी से ताज़ा,\nसीधे आपके द्वार तक' in Hindi. Top bar, filter tabs, section H2s, footer trust badges (3 of 4) and search placeholder all switch. Persistence: after page.reload(), lang_val=Tamil and all Tamil strings still rendered. No pageerror events (previous 't is not a function' regression resolved). Bug can be closed; two minor consistency polish items listed under action_items.
